description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mudduwa, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District   -  Cad. Map No. 620273
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
